tasks.description: Design and implement a passwordless authentication system using magic email links. This system should send a one-time login link to the user's email address, allowing them to sign in without entering a password. Ensure the system is secure and eliminates credential-theft risk.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid email address, when the user requests a login link, then a one-time login link is sent to the user's email address
Given a valid one-time login link, when the user clicks the link, then the user is signed in to the platform

tasks.description: Design and implement a login screen that presents a username field and does not include a password field, as the system is passwordless. Ensure the screen is accessible, mobile-friendly, and localized.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login screen, when the user views the screen, then the screen displays a username field and does not display a password field
Given the login screen, when the user views the screen on a mobile device, then the screen is displayed correctly and is usable

tasks.description: Design and implement a system that generates one-time login links and sends them to the user's email address. Ensure the links are secure and can only be used once.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid email address, when the system generates a one-time login link, then the link is sent to the user's email address and can only be used once

tasks.description: Design and implement a system that expires session tokens after a period of inactivity. Ensure the system is secure and prevents session hijacking.
acceptance_criteria: Given a session token, when the user is inactive for a period of time, then the session token expires and can no longer be used

tasks.description: Remove the password field from the login screen, as the system is passwordless. Ensure the screen is updated correctly and does not display any password-related fields or errors.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login screen, when the user views the screen, then the screen does not display a password field

tasks.description: Design and implement a feature flag that allows the passwordless authentication system to be rolled out to a subset of users. Ensure the flag can be easily toggled and the system can be rolled back if necessary.
acceptance_criteria: Given the feature flag, when the flag is enabled, then the passwordless authentication system is active for the subset of users
Given the feature flag, when the flag is disabled, then the passwordless authentication system is inactive and the old authentication system is used

tasks.description: Design and implement a system that collects metrics on login success rate and time-to-login. Ensure the system is secure and does not collect any sensitive user data.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login metrics system, when the user logs in, then the system collects metrics on login success rate and time-to-login

tasks.description: Design and implement a rollout plan that allows the passwordless authentication system to be rolled out to 10% of users first, then expanded to all users. Ensure the plan is secure and can be easily monitored and adjusted.
acceptance_criteria: Given the rollout plan, when the plan is executed, then the passwordless authentication system is rolled out to 10% of users first, then expanded to all users

tasks.description: Write documentation for the passwordless authentication system, including setup instructions, troubleshooting guides, and API documentation. Ensure the documentation is clear, concise, and easy to understand.
acceptance_criteria: Given the documentation, when the user reads the documentation, then the user can understand how to set up and use the passwordless authentication system
